title: Paired-transfer distributed-tree orbit BSGS with charged fixed-side precomputation

claims.statement: For the full protected fixed-G1 pairing inversion problem, the adjacent-node tree algorithm in proof.md returns a valid G2 preimage with success exactly L/r>0.39, m=39*2^121 and L=m*(2m-1). Total cold classical work, summing all processors and charging initialization, every transfer, failed query, merge/search operation, preprocessing, pairings, output and verification, is at most 2^130 dense-Fp12 reference equivalents at fixed C=20000. All loads/stores use bounded local 64-bit addresses and all inter-node messages are explicitly counted. Peak total memory is below 2^145 bytes; preprocessing below 2^130 equivalents is included; nonuniform advice is zero bytes. This is an analytical upper bound, not a practical production attack.
